passage.label: O believed shall I guide you transaction save painful punishment; believe Allah Messenger strive cause Allah wealth lives best should know; forgive sins admit gardens rivers flow pleasant dwellings perpetual residence great attainment; another favor love victory Allah imminent conquest give good tidings believers; O believed be supporters Allah as Jesus son Mary said disciples who are my supporters Allah; disciples said we are supporters Allah; faction Children Israel believed faction disbelieved; supported those believed against enemy became dominant

arabicExcerpts.text: يَـٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُواْ هَلۡ أَدُلُّكُمۡ عَلَىٰ تِجَٰرَةٖ تُنجِيكُم مِّنۡ عَذَابٍ أَلِيمٖ
تُؤۡمِنُونَ بِٱللَّهِ وَرَسُولِهِۦ وَتُجَٰهِدُونَ فِي سَبِيلِ ٱللَّهِ بِأَمۡوَٰلِكُمۡ وَأَنفُسِكُمۡۚ ذَٰلِكُمۡ خَيۡرٞ لَّكُمۡ إِن كُنتُمۡ تَعۡلَمُونَ
يَغۡفِرۡ لَكُمۡ ذُنُوبَكُمۡ وَيُدۡخِلۡكُمۡ جَنَّـٰتٖ تَجۡرِي مِن تَحۡتِهَا ٱلۡأَنۡهَٰرُ وَمَسَٰكِنَ طَيِّبَةٗ فِي جَنَّـٰتِ عَدۡنٖۚ ذَٰلِكَ ٱلۡفَوۡزُ ٱلۡعَظِيمُ
وَأُخۡرَىٰ تُحِبُّونَهَاۖ نَصۡرٞ مِّنَ ٱللَّهِ وَفَتۡحٞ قَرِيبٞۗ وَبَشِّرِ ٱلۡمُؤۡمِنِينَ

يَـٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُواْ كُونُوٓاْ أَنصَارَ ٱللَّهِ كَمَا قَالَ عِيسَى ٱبۡنُ مَرۡيَمَ لِلۡحَوَارِيِّـۧنَ مَنۡ أَنصَارِيٓ إِلَى ٱللَّهِۖ قَالَ ٱلۡحَوَارِيُّونَ نَحۡنُ أَنصَارُ ٱللَّهِۖ فَـَٔامَنَت طَّآئِفَةٞ مِّنۢ بَنِيٓ إِسۡرَـٰٓءِيلَ وَكَفَرَت طَّآئِفَةٞۖ فَأَيَّدۡنَا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُواْ عَلَىٰ عَدُوِّهِمۡ فَأَصۡبَحُواْ ظَٰهِرِينَ

mainSubject.label: Believers offered a trade that saves from painful punishment: believing in Allah and His Messenger and striving in His cause with wealth and lives, named the best if they knew; the reward comprising forgiveness of sins, admission to rivered gardens and pleasant dwellings in perpetual residence as the great attainment; an additional beloved favour of victory from Allah and imminent conquest announced with glad tidings to believers; the command to be Allah's supporters as Isa asked his disciples who would support him for Allah, they answering we are the supporters; Israel split into believing and disbelieving factions, with Allah supporting the believers against their enemy until they became dominant

notes: Wave 9 genuine re-extraction. Boundaries follow the text: P1 closes with the firm-rank imagery (4) before the Musa narrative opens (5); P2 ends with the religion-of-truth prevalence declaration (9) before the saving-trade offer begins (10); P3 runs from that offer through the victory promise, the hawariyyun dialogue and the closing dominance statement (10-14).
